project.name: Trip Hop Arrangement - Mainstream Aggressive Slow Build

arrangement.notes: Arrangement features a slow build energy profile, starting with subdued intro leading into progressively more aggressive and dynamic sections, culminating in high energy hooks and maintaining trip hop feel.

event_markers.label: intro_drums_low
event_markers.reason: soft drum sample chopped with slice technique

event_markers.label: drums_breakbeat_slicing
event_markers.reason: introduce chopped breakbeat samples for aggressive feel

event_markers.label: bass_grain_stretch
event_markers.reason: add granular stretched bass layers to increase texture

event_markers.label: chords_reverse_chops
event_markers.reason: use reversed chopped chord samples for tension

event_markers.label: fx_time_stretch_slicers
event_markers.reason: apply time-stretch slicing effects to FX for climax

sound_intent.description: Create an aggressive yet atmospheric trip hop arrangement with a slow energy build; samples and channel names reflect chopping and slicing techniques to provide rhythmic complexity.

routing_intent.description: Channels routed to separate buses by sample chopping technique, allowing layered control of sliced, chopped, and stretched sample groups.

track_roles.drums: rhythmic foundation using slice and chop techniques
track_roles.bass: textural low-end using grain and slice methods
track_roles.chords: atmospheric harmonic support with reversed and stuttered chops
track_roles.melody: lead motifs built from sliced and granular sample techniques
track_roles.vocal: vocal chops and stutters enhancing mood and aggression
track_roles.fx: sample-based effects with time-stretch and filter chopping

designer_intent.goals: Maintain tension and aggression while ensuring accessible mainstream trip hop appeal with slow energy build.

presetor_intent.goals: Presets should emphasize clarity on chopped and sliced samples with space for dynamic build.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate rhythmic drum patterns featuring sliced and chopped breakbeat samples to drive slow build energy.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass lines layered with grain stretch and sample slices to complement moods and sustain aggression.

harmony_generator.brief: Develop chord textures using reversed chops and stutter effects to add tension and atmosphere.

melody_generator.brief: Produce melodic elements built from sliced and granular samples without explicit melodies.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement dynamics, energy curve, and textural variation for mainstream trip hop with aggressive feel.

presetor.brief: Assign presets to highlight sample chop techniques, emphasizing rhythmic articulation and clarity.

songgps.brief: Manage arrangement sections and energy curve to enforce slow energy build with marked transitions.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix channels preserving sample chopping clarity and dynamics, ensuring clean audio delivery.
